areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Linear parks protect vegetation, water resources and floodplains, with ecological drainage control and cycle paths; water and biodiversity impacts were counted here.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Drainage, paving and urban infrastructure works take a substantial share of the financing.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Community facilities for low-income populations, including social assistance centres and a shelter renovation.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Construction of health centres and related health facilities with a defined share of the financing.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: LED lighting touches energy efficiency only indirectly, with no other supporting information.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Water-resources and springs impacts already supported the score under 1.1.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Biodiversity impacts already supported the score under 1.1.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Potential for new business from some products is not enough; no actions directly improving the economy or business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Public wi-fi is claimed to benefit small firms, but no actions directly affect the economy for them.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No direct correlation between the bus terminal or training programme and effective job and income generation for vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: No inclusion action aimed specifically at minorities among beneficiaries.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: School climate training does not target youth as defined by law; only a minor share of that age group is covered.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: No actions improving or innovating service delivery, management or participation.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Public wi-fi is widely diffused and not technological innovation or modernization.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: No financing arrangements encouraging private participation.
